Input1 is her original painted portrait: use ONLY for identity, dark wavy hair, adult age, complexion, crown and restrained plum/gold color cues. Do NOT copy painted rendering or all-over brocade fromInput1.
NEW FORMAT: square canvas, ideally1536x1536. Exactly one young adult queen, head, shoulders and upper chest, three-quarter pose, open confident expression. A complete circular medallion centered on canvas, diameter94% ofcanvas; simple narrow antique-gold rim and one thin dark outline. All hair, crown and shoulders lie inside circle. Rich but restrained color: warm natural olive skin, dark chestnut hair, muted plum cloak/robe, cream collar, small antique-gold crown/clasps/earrings. Moderate color saturation, readable jewel tones, no neon. Distinct flat color shapes, no soft painted realism, no engraved dense hatching or ornamental texture. Crown fullyvisible, modest court clothing. No Japanese kimono or modern accessories.
NO TEXT, LETTERS, NUMBERS, NAME LABELS, SPEECH BUBBLES, SOUND EFFECTS, BANNERS, SCROLLS, LOGOS OR WATERMARKS. Exactly one circular portrait on transparent canvas, not a page or collage.
